timing: The strongest window is tomorrow, September 10; if not then, September 16 works. A slower echo could come around September 22, and if this truly needs months to settle, November 7 to December 6 is the real horizon.

timing: Look for a real shift around late September — the 21st or so — when a window of clarity opens. But the decisive moment comes next spring, from March 6 to April 4, 2027. That's when the venture can truly take root.

verdict: Passing is possible, but only if you put in steady, incremental work between now and February. The exam itself is not against you, yet your own preparation must be consistent and thorough.
